# Game Idea: Asteroid Escape

- **Genre**: Arcade survival
- **Core mechanic**: Player controls a small ship with arrow keys on an HTML canvas. Asteroids spawn at random positions on the top edge and drift downward with varying speeds.
- **Goal**: Survive as long as possible while collecting randomly‑appearing fuel cells to keep the ship powered.
- **Lose condition**: Collision with an asteroid or depletion of fuel ends the game.
- **Features**: Simple graphics (shapes), score based on time survived and fuel collected, increasing difficulty over time.

1: // Asteroid Escape game
2: // Canvas with id="game"
3: (() => {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   if (!canvas) return;
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   const W = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 400;
8:   const H = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
9: 
10:   // Audio setup
11:   const AudioCtx = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
12:   const audioCtx = new AudioCtx();
13:   // Ensure context is resumed on first user interaction
14:   const resumeAudio = () => { if (audioCtx.state !== 'running') audioCtx.resume(); };
15:   document.addEventListener('keydown', resumeAudio, {once: true});
16: 
17:   function playTone(freq, type='sine', dur=0.2) {
18:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
19:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
20:     osc.type = type;
21:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
22:     osc.connect(gain);
23:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
24:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime);
25:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.01);
26:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + dur);
27:     osc.start(audioCtx.currentTime);
28:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + dur);
29:   }
30: 
31:   // Ship
32:   const ship = { x: W / 2, y: H - 40, w: 30, h: 30, speed: 4 };
33:   let fuel = 100; // percent
34:   let score = 0;
35:   const keys = {};
36:   document.addEventListener('keydown', e => keys[e.key] = true);
37:   document.addEventListener('keyup', e => keys[e.key] = false);
38: 
39:   // Entities
40:   const asteroids = [];
41:   const fuels = [];
42:   const stars = [];
43:   let lastAsteroid = 0, lastFuel = 0;
44:   let gameOver = false;
45: 
46:   // Initialize background stars
47:   function initStars(count = 100) {
48:     for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
49:       stars.push({
50:         x: Math.random() * W,
51:         y: Math.random() * H,
52:         r: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5,
53:         alpha: Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.5
54:       });
55:     }
56:   }
57:   initStars();
58: 
59:   function spawnAsteroid() {
60:     const size = 20 + Math.random() * 30;
61:     asteroids.push({
62:       x: Math.random() * (W - size),
63:       y: -size,
64:       w: size,
65:       h: size,
66:       speed: 1 + Math.random() * 2 + score / 5000
67:     });
68:   }
69: 
70:   function spawnFuel() {
71:     const size = 15;
72:     fuels.push({
73:       x: Math.random() * (W - size),
74:       y: -size,
75:       w: size,
76:       h: size,
77:       speed: 1.5
78:     });
79:   }
80: 
81:   function update(dt) {
82:     if (gameOver) return;
83:     // Ship movement
84:     if (keys.ArrowLeft) ship.x -= ship.speed;
85:     if (keys.ArrowRight) ship.x += ship.speed;
86:     if (keys.ArrowUp) ship.y -= ship.speed;
87:     if (keys.ArrowDown) ship.y += ship.speed;
88:     // Keep within bounds
89:     ship.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(W - ship.w, ship.x));
90:     ship.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(H - ship.h, ship.y));
91: 
92:     // Spawn asteroids every 1‑1.5s
93:     if (Date.now() - lastAsteroid > 1000 + Math.random() * 500) {
94:       spawnAsteroid();
95:       lastAsteroid = Date.now();
96:     }
97:     // Spawn fuel occasionally
98:     if (Date.now() - lastFuel > 5000 + Math.random() * 5000) {
99:       spawnFuel();
100:       lastFuel = Date.now();
101:     }
102: 
103:     // Update asteroids
104:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
105:       const a = asteroids[i];
106:       a.y += a.speed;
107:       if (a.y > H) asteroids.splice(i, 1);
108:     }
109:     // Update fuels
110:     for (let i = fuels.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
111:       const f = fuels[i];
112:       f.y += f.speed;
113:       if (f.y > H) fuels.splice(i, 1);
114:     }
115:     // Update background stars (twinkling & drift)
116:     for (let i = stars.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
117:       const s = stars[i];
118:       s.y += 0.3; // slow drift
119:       if (s.y > H) { s.y = 0; s.x = Math.random() * W; }
120:       // twinkle
121:       s.alpha = Math.max(0.3, Math.min(1, s.alpha + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.05));
122:     }
123: 
124:     // Collisions
125:     function rectCollision(r1, r2) {
126:       return !(r2.x > r1.x + r1.w ||
127:                r2.x + r2.w < r1.x ||
128:                r2.y > r1.y + r1.h ||
129:                r2.y + r2.h < r1.y);
130:     }
131:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
132:       if (rectCollision(ship, asteroids[i])) {
133:         // Collision sound
134:         playTone(150, 'square', 0.3);
135:         gameOver = true;
136:         break;
137:       }
138:     }
139:     for (let i = fuels.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
140:       if (rectCollision(ship, fuels[i])) {
141:         // Fuel collect sound
142:         playTone(600, 'triangle', 0.15);
143:         fuel = Math.min(100, fuel + 20);
144:         fuels.splice(i, 1);
145:       }
146:     }
147: 
148:     // Fuel consumption & score
149:     fuel -= dt * 0.01; // drains over time
150:     if (fuel <= 0) gameOver = true;
151:     score += dt;
152:   }
153: 
154:   function draw() {
155:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
156:     // Background stars
157:     stars.forEach(s => {
158:       ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${s.alpha})`;
159:       ctx.beginPath();
160:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r, 0, Math.PI*2);
161:       ctx.fill();
162:     });
163:     // Ship
164:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
165:     ctx.beginPath();
166:     ctx.moveTo(ship.x + ship.w / 2, ship.y);
167:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x, ship.y + ship.h);
168:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w, ship.y + ship.h);
169:     ctx.closePath();
170:     ctx.fill();
171:     // Asteroids - draw as circles
172:     ctx.fillStyle = '#777';
173:     asteroids.forEach(a => {
174:       ctx.beginPath();
175:       ctx.arc(a.x + a.w/2, a.y + a.h/2, Math.max(a.w, a.h)/2, 0, Math.PI*2);
176:       ctx.fill();
177:     });
178:     // Fuel cells - draw as small stars
179:     ctx.fillStyle = '#ff0';
180:     fuels.forEach(f => {
181:       ctx.beginPath();
182:       const cx = f.x + f.w/2;
183:       const cy = f.y + f.h/2;
184:       const r = Math.min(f.w, f.h)/2;
185:       // Move to first point
186:       let first = true;
187:       for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
188:         const angle = (i * 2 * Math.PI) / 5 - Math.PI/2;
189:         const x = cx + r * Math.cos(angle);
190:         const y = cy + r * Math.sin(angle);
191:         if (first) { ctx.moveTo(x, y); first = false; } else { ctx.lineTo(x, y); }
192:       }
193:       ctx.closePath();
194:       ctx.fill();
195:     });
196:     // HUD
197:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
198:     ctx.font = '14px sans-serif';
199:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${Math.floor(score / 1000)}`, 10, 20);
200:     ctx.fillText(`Fuel: ${Math.max(0, Math.floor(fuel))}%`, 10, 40);
201:     if (gameOver) {
202:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
203:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
204:       ctx.fillStyle = '#f00';
205:       ctx.font = '30px sans-serif';
206:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', W / 2 - 80, H / 2);
207:     }
208:   }
209:

211:       ctx.fill();
212:     });

216:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${Math.floor(score / 1000)}`, 10, 20);
217:     ctx.fillText(`Fuel: ${Math.max(0, Math.floor(fuel))}%`, 10, 40);
218:     if (gameOver) {

222:       ctx.font = '30px sans-serif';

224:     }
225:   }
226: 
227:   let last = performance.now();
228:   function loop(now) {
229:     const dt = now - last;

232:     draw();
